full_judgment: Abdur Rahman Chowdhury, J.—This rule arises out of an application for bail. This is a long pending matter and we are directing a departmental enquiry as to why and how this Rule was kept pending before this Court with the records of the tower Court lying here for the last six years. Be that as it may, records of the case reveal no very serious offence where an amount of Taka two lacs and sixty thousand was looted away in broad day light in the city of Dacca killing one of the armed guards of the Bank on the spot in the process. No name was mentioned in the First Information Report lodged by the Chief Manager of the Pubali Bank, Motijheel Commercial Area, Dacca. But, subsequently, in course of investigation the petitioner along with 7 others were arrested in connection with the alleged offence under section 396 of the Penal Code read with President's Order No. 50 of 1972. Seven of the accused persons were baited out by the learned Sub-Divisional Magistrate and the present petitioner, it appears, was enlarged on bail by this Court on 16th October, 1974.
